Chapter 1116: 35: The Great Lord Is Invincible (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1116: Chapter 35: The Great Lord is Invincible (Seeking Subscription)

The world is vast and boundless.

Behind the battlefield of the Purple Dream Domain, two figures stand in the void, overlooking the distant battlefield.

The one standing slightly behind is Spirit Might King, who as a king conferred by the royal family of the Da Ling Ancient Country, has strategically initiated this war affecting several dozen surrounding domains.

Since the war started, on the main battlefields of the two domains, it’s been the Purple Dream Domain holding the advantage, while the Qingfen Domain primarily focuses on defense.

“I’ve almost figured out that Red Pine King’s tactics. This war still needs you, brother, to take action and decide the outcome.”

Spirit Might King looked at the figure to his front left.

It was his brother, King Lingshen of the core royal bloodline of the Da Ling Ancient Country.

In the source world, among many ancient countries, it is extremely rare for the ancestral bloodline concentration to reach the level of the core royal bloodline, even rarer than the numbers of Heavenly Venerates.

A member of the core royal bloodline, once stepping into the realm of Great Lord, can easily sweep through opponents of the same rank after a brief period of adaptation.

The powerful Bloodline Power of the ancestor grants every member of the core royal bloodline an overwhelming battle prowess.

If Bloodline Power can be unleashed to its maximum potential, the core royal bloodline at the realm of Great Lord can challenge the Heavenly Venerates.

Of course, even for the core royal bloodline, achieving the maximum unleashing of Bloodline Power is not an easy task.

But it is still far simpler than a Great Lord breaking through to become a Heavenly Venerate.

“Cultivation is the foundation of all things in this world,” King Lingshen glanced at Spirit Might King, “Is the throne that important to you, brother?”

“Very important.” Spirit Might King admitted.

Becoming an emperor of an Ancient Country offers many benefits, including purifying the royal bloodline within.

For members of the core royal bloodline, their bloodline concentration is nearly overflowing and cannot be enhanced further, but for the ordinary royal bloodline, the allure of purifying the bloodline concentration is substantial.

However, for Spirit Might King, purifying his bloodline concentration is not his sole reason for aiming to become an emperor; what he values more is wielding imperial power.

“I don’t have your talent, little brother; becoming emperor is my only hope.”

Spirit Might King sighed.

He also felt somewhat helpless.

Although he and King Lingshen were brothers, they were not particularly close. For this occasion, Spirit Might King paid a significant effort to invite King Lingshen to intervene.

“Understood.”

After a moment of silence, King Lingshen spoke: “This time, I will help you completely eliminate all obstacles in this war, brother.”

“Little brother, that King Chijue is not easy to deal with.” Spirit Might King was shocked and quickly reminded.

King Chijue was the third brother of Red Pine King and also a member of the core royal bloodline.

When it comes to cultivation years, King Chijue far surpasses King Lingshen. Spirit Might King’s expectation was simply for King Lingshen to hold King Chijue at bay.

“King Chijue?”

King Lingshen’s tone was calm, “A core royal bloodline member who hasn’t grown to the limit is not my match.”

Core royal bloodline members can challenge Heavenly Venerates as Great Lords, but not without conditions; their bloodline must be pushed to the limit.

The threshold between a Great Lord and a Heavenly Venerate is not easily crossed, even with the rich enhancement of a thirteenth-tier life bloodline.

“Your bloodline, little brother…” Spirit Might King’s pupils contracted, looking at his brother incredulously.

“Yes.”

King Lingshen nodded.

“Good, good, good.” Spirit Might King felt an overwhelming joy.

A core royal bloodline member whose bloodline has been fully exploited is considered the strongest force beneath the Heavenly Venerates.

That King Chijue hasn’t had any news of reaching his full potential over the years.

It means that once King Lingshen and King Chijue engage in combat, the ultimate victor will surely be King Lingshen.

“Perhaps, little brother is right; cultivation is indeed the foundation?”

In the midst of joy, Spirit Might King’s mind suddenly floated this thought, but it was quickly replaced by joy, “Whatever, let’s eradicate Qingfen Domain first.”

…

Qingfen Domain.

Red Pine King and King Chijue were similarly standing at the front of the battlefield.

“The decisive battle should begin.”

Red Pine King gazed distantly at the battlefield.

The war had already lasted five hundred years, with both sides having clashed multiple times.

Intense battles between peak Great Lords frequently appeared.

Red Pine King had a premonition that Spirit Might King was growing restless over there.

“Third brother, I’ll need your help next.” Red Pine King spoke.

“No problem.” King Chijue smiled at Red Pine King, “Leave King Lingshen to me; I’ve long heard of his astounding ancestral bloodline from the Da Ling Ancient Country, and today I can finally witness it.”

“King Lingshen, his reputation is indeed great.” Red Pine King nodded.

King Lingshen is the youngest core royal bloodline member of the Da Ling Ancient Country, it is said that when his bloodline concentration was tested, it directly triggered an ancestral phenomenon.

“Third brother, should I continue to ask a few more royal kings to come?” Red Pine King considered and then asked.

“Can you summon them?” King Chijue glanced at Red Pine King and laughed: “Furthermore, if you continue to ask for royal kings, then Spirit Might King will ask for more as well, escalating the intensity of the war.”

Wars between Ancient Countries often occur, but they tacitly keep the intensity restrained.

Normally.

In regional wars involving dozens of domains, having a royal king stationed as the peak is sufficient, inviting more royal kings? Besides the exponentially increased costs, the war intensity will rise.

Once the eyes are blood-red, affected domains grow in number, triggering comprehensive war between Ancient Countries, involving numerous powerful Heavenly Venerates.

That scene is what can be truly deemed out of control.

Even the ambitious Spirit Might King does not wish to face such a situation; if the war intensity exceeds his control, even if he wins the war, the achieved merit might not outweigh what he has now.
